# This Week prep: Tue Oct 27, 2026 session
**Status: approved by Jeffrey (relayed by Grok Bot, Tue Oct 27, 6:05 PM PT). No send, post, trade, buy, or spend comes with it.** This is analysis only. No trades, sends, or posts.
Hal compiled it Tue Oct 27 at about 4:55 AM PT from board jobs 001-2026-10-26-1 (Cash Money), -2 (Compass), and -3 (SiteScout), and added AMT's Q3 release (filed 4:03 AM PT) from AMT's own 8-K. All three worker jobs are done (needs_review; the 5:30 AM checker has not reviewed them yet). Closes are Monday Oct 26 from the [Yahoo chart API](https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/SPY?interval=1d&range=6mo).

## The setup in one paragraph
Monday was a light-volume bounce for the market (SPY +0.71%, still under its EMA9 and 20-day per Cash Money; S&P +0.70%, Nasdaq +0.82% on Anthropic's IPO filing and chips per [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/25/stock-market-today-live-updates.html)). Communication services was the weak spot. VZ beat on EPS and raised guidance but missed revenue and fell 3.49%. SPCX's 328.4M-share unlock day passed quietly (-0.40%, about average volume). Brazil crashed (EWZ -19.82%), yet AMT (-0.37%) and SBAC (+0.63%) barely moved. There's still no signed SpaceX tower deal and no denial; every Monday story recycles the Oct 22 Bloomberg report ([Inside Towers](https://insidetowers.com/spacex-talks-of-80000-sites-continues-boost-to-tower-market/)). **AMT reported this morning: beat-and-raise, no SpaceX mention** (section below). Still ahead this week: TMUS earnings and the Fed on Wed Oct 28, and the FCC satellite/D2D meeting Thu Oct 29.

**Hal's read (inference):** AMT's release gives the bulls nothing new on SpaceX, so today's tower tape is about the numbers and the 5:30 AM PT call. The useful line is Cash Money's: AMT holding 185.4–186 keeps the swing idea alive for Wed–Fri, and an open under 182.78 says the market is rejecting the tower story. Premarket so far (thin, below) has AMT trading inside that band.

## AMT Q3 2026 results (added 4:55 AM PT)
Source: AMT's press release, Exhibit 99.1 to the 8-K filed Oct 27 at 7:03 AM ET ([EX-99.1](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1053507/000105350726000154/pressreleaseq32026.htm), [8-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1053507/000105350726000154/amt-20261027.htm)).
- Total revenue $2,785M, up 2.5% y/y. Property revenue $2,734M, up 4.5%, on 1.1% organic tenant billings growth and 16.3% cash revenue growth in Data Centers.
- Net income attributable to common $766M, down 10.3%; **$1.64 per diluted share**, down 9.9% (hit by about $71.5M of unrealized equity-investment losses).
- **AFFO per share $2.87, up 3.2%.** AFFO to common $1,335M, up 2.4%. Adjusted EBITDA $1,832M, up 0.9%. Free cash flow $986M.
- Bought back about $315M of stock in Q3 (1.8M shares) plus $68M through Oct 20. **On Oct 23 the board added $2.0B** to the buyback on top of about $1.1B remaining.
- Agreed to sell its Canada business for about C$288M (about $202M), expected to close in Q4.
- **FY26 outlook raised (the release says third time this year):** AFFO per share $11.04–11.16, midpoint up $0.02; property revenue $10,785–10,865M, midpoint up $55M on Data Centers; adjusted EBITDA $7,248–7,303M, midpoint unchanged; net income midpoint down $30M on equity-security losses.
- **Brazil:** the outlook assumes 5.10 reais per dollar for Oct 27–Dec 31. Monday's USD/BRL close was 5.4154 per SiteScout ([Exame](https://exame.com/invest/mercados/ibovespa-fecha-em-baixa-de-139-maior-queda-diaria-em-6-anos-dolar-dispara-82/)), so the guide's FX assumption is stronger than Monday's spot (Hal's comparison of two sourced figures; the impact size isn't in the release). Latin America organic tenant billings outlook is about -3%.
- **SpaceX:** the release does not mention SpaceX, Starlink, satellite, or the cell-site talks (text search of EX-99.1). Call commentary at 5:30 AM PT is **pending**.
- Versus the consensus SiteScout found (GAAP EPS about $1.64 on about $2.76B revenue, [Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/earnings/american-tower-earnings-ahead-can-tower-demand-offset-eps-slide-93CH-4973113)): EPS in line, revenue a bit above. That's Hal's arithmetic on the two sourced figures; no AFFO consensus was sourced (**unverified**).
- Premarket: AMT's thin Yahoo 5-minute premarket bars after the release ranged 184.55–189.90, last 187.00 at 4:35 AM PT ([Yahoo 5m](https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/AMT?interval=5m&range=1d&includePrePost=true); premarket bars carry no volume, so treat as **unverified** price discovery).

Levels and bias are Cash Money's (job 001-2026-10-26-1). Indicators were chosen per chart: VWAP and opening range on event days (AMT, VZ, CCI/SBAC, SPCX), EMA9/EMA20 on clean trends (SPCX, T, TMUS, VZ), the 200-day where price sits at it, unfilled gaps, 5-day volume nodes where volume is concentrated, ATR14 for range. # This Week prep: Mon Oct 26, 2026 session
**Status: approved by Jeffrey (relayed by Grok Bot, Tue Oct 27, 6:05 PM PT). No send, post, trade, buy, or spend comes with it.** This is analysis only. No trades, sends, or posts.
Hal compiled it Mon Oct 26, about 1:15 AM PT, and updated it about 4:50 AM PT with Verizon's Q3 release, from board jobs 001-2026-10-25-1 (Cash Money), -2 (Compass), and -3 (SiteScout). Prices are Friday Oct 23 closes from the [Yahoo chart API](https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/SPY?interval=1d&range=1y). No premarket data was available when this was compiled.

## The setup in one paragraph
Bloomberg reported Thursday night that SpaceX is in talks to access about 80,000 US cell sites for Starlink Mobile. This is anonymously sourced and no lease has been announced ([Yahoo/Bloomberg](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/articles/spacex-talks-access-80-000-213142634.html), [CNBC Oct 25](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/25/spacex-cell-sites-wireless-network.html)). On Friday, carriers sold off and tower stocks rallied (T -7.96%, TMUS -7.71%, CCI +9.06%, AMT +4.08%, SBAC +3.57%, per [FinanceFeeds](https://financefeeds.com/att-stock-down-7-96-percent-spacex-cell-sites/)). This week brings four events: VZ earnings Monday, AMT Tuesday, TMUS and the Fed Wednesday, and an FCC meeting on satellite and D2D spectrum Thursday ([FCC agenda](https://www.fcc.gov/October2026)).

**Hal's read (inference):** This is a week of scheduled events. Most of the edge comes from letting each report land, then trading the reaction rather than guessing ahead of it. VZ's 4:00 AM PT release sets the tone for T and TMUS at the open.

## Per ticker
Levels and bias are Cash Money's. Indicators were chosen per chart: VWAP and the opening range on event days, EMA9/EMA20 on fast-trend names, the 200-day where price sits right at it, unfilled gaps, and ATR14 for expected range.

## VZ Q3 2026 results (added 4:50 AM PT)
Source: Verizon's press release filed as Exhibit 99 to today's 8-K ([EX-99](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/732712/000073271226000049/a2026q3exhibit99.htm), [filing index](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/732712/000073271226000049/0000732712-26-000049-index.htm)).
- Adjusted EPS $1.31, up 8.3% y/y; GAAP EPS $1.25, up 6.8%.
- Total operating revenue $34.3B, up 1.5% y/y. Mobility and broadband service revenue $23.5B, up 2.9%; equipment revenue down 9.0% on fewer upgrades and lower subsidies.
- Postpaid phone net adds 406,000 (best Q3 in five years); postpaid net accounts +137,000; postpaid phone churn 0.94%, down 4 bps y/y. Broadband net adds 314,000 (159K fixed wireless, 155K fiber).
- Adjusted EBITDA $13.8B, up 8.0%, margin 40.2%. Q3 free cash flow $7.8B, up 12.1%.
- Signed a $2.0B+ AI infrastructure agreement with AWS.
- **Guidance raised (third straight quarter):** FY26 adjusted EPS $5.04–5.06 (7.0–7.5% growth, from 6.0–7.0%); postpaid phone net adds 1.1–1.2M (from upper half of 750K–1.0M); operating cash flow growth 3.5–5.0% (from 2.0–4.0%); FCF growth approaching 12% (from 9–10%); service revenue growth in the upper half of 2.5–3.0%, about 4% in Q4. Capex unchanged at $16.0–16.5B.
- Versus the MarketBeat consensus above: adjusted EPS beat ($1.31 vs about $1.27) and revenue came in under ($34.3B vs about $34.8B). That comparison is Hal's arithmetic on the two sourced figures.
- The release does not mention SpaceX, Starlink, or the cell-site talks. Premarket price reaction was not checked in this run (**unverified**); Cash Money's VZ levels and bias above were set before the report and were not updated.

## Cross-cutting this week
- **Fed decision Wed Oct 28.** About 90% odds of a hold, and BofA calls for a 25bp hike. Rate-sensitive tower REITs and high-dividend telecoms are the exposed names ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/25/stock-market-today-live-updates.html)).
- **Brazil:** EWZ fell about 18–20% overnight after the runoff, and AMT and SBAC have large Latin America exposure ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/25/stock-market-today-live-updates.html)). This may weigh on the towers Monday (inference).
- **SPCX:** Musk says SpaceX "closed" $40B of mostly callable GPU debt; Reuters says the terms are unclear ([Investing/Reuters](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/musk-says-spacex-raised-40-billion-in-debt-for-gpus-4971248)).
- **Futures** were slightly green Sunday night: S&P +0.25% ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/25/stock-market-today-live-updates.html)).

## Unverified / caveats
- The SpaceX cell-site story is anonymously sourced talks, not a deal, and the Bloomberg original wasn't opened directly.
- The SPCX unlock share counts come from third-party trackers and Stocktwits, not the prospectus.
- X claims that CCI rose 11.6–15.7% Friday conflict with the +9.06% close.
- An Alphastreet VZ preview price of $41.29 conflicts with Yahoo's $44.66 and was treated as stale.
- Round-number supports aren't tested shelves.
